caption:
Skiing on a living volcano. The fumaroles on Asahi Dake never stop steaming, and the skin track runs right past them — sulphur in the air, steam drifting across the slope, and above it all, blue sky.

It's a strange feeling the first time: the mountain quietly breathing next to you while you climb. Then you point your skis down and forget everything else.

We take small groups up here every winter. Send us a message if you want in next season.
